subject.title: Ocean View School District Board, Trustee Area 5

text: Planning Commissioner/Businessowner

As a 3rd generation Huntington Beach resident and homeowner, I understand the needs of the community. Our suburban neighborhoods value public schools that are safe and focus on student achievement. I am running for the Ocean View School District Board of Trustees for one reason; our children.

My education credentials include a BS in Aerospace Engineering and an MS in Supply Chain Management where I continue to serve CSULB in an advisory role. My career in Transportation has allowed me to give back to local communities where I donate time at colleges and high schools to mentor and educate youth about college and career opportunities in the Transportation sector.

I have a passion for public service and being actively involved in my childrens school, where I serve as Chairman of the Village View Elementary School Site Council. Also serving the city of Huntington Beach as a Planning Commissioner and formerly as a Public Works Commissioner, I value the importance of good governance and want to extend my community contributions districtwide to affect positive change in what matters most, our children.
When the district tried closing schools I worked closely with parents in a grass-roots effort and succeeded in keeping our schools open.
As an advocate for taxpayers, I will promote fiscal responsibility and address the structural budget deficit without raising your taxes. Let me repeat, I will not raise your taxes.
My goal is for the district to get back to the basics including math, science, reading, writing, and history.
I will support curriculum that emphasizes STEM/STEAM principles and programs like the Environmental Science Farm at Golden View Elementary.
I will advocate for policies that prioritize student achievement.
I will keep parents involved in their childrens education.

While parents are asked to donate money for field trips, district Administration continues to receive raises. While test scores continue to decline, the board is focusing on building workforce housing on closed school sites.
It's time for change.

The district needs a community-focused leader who will promote accountability and make informed decisions. I am invested in our community and dedicated to creating a positive lasting impact on our children's education and well-being.
Please vote for David Clifford.
Visit www.clifford4ovsd.com to read my full story.

text: Appointed Governing Board Member, Ocean View School District

This campaign isn’t about politics. It’s about Service, Stewardship, and Results—doing what is needed to ensure every student is safe, every family is heard, and every school has the support it needs to succeed.

Hello, my name is Jennifer Rank. I am the wife of Adam Rank, an on-air analyst for the NFL Network, and we are the proud parents of two Ocean View School District students. My family has deep roots in education. My mother is a retired teacher at Bethany Christian Academy and principal who served our community for more than 30 years. Growing up in a household shaped by an educator’s dedication, I began my own path.

I care deeply about our schools and am honored to have been appointed by unanimous decision to serve as an Ocean View School District Board Member. With Your Support—Your Vote, I look forward to continuing to serve.

Our school district is recognized throughout California for its educational excellence. Beyond party labels, families want the highest quality educational experience for their children: strong fundamental skills in reading, math, and science, access to arts, music, and physical education, and leaders who use taxpayer dollars responsibly.

Through my roles as PTA President at Harbour View Elementary and President of the Ocean View School District PTA/PTO Roundtable, I have collaborated with PTA/PTO leaders across all 13 elementary and middle schools. This experience has provided me with firsthand insight into both the hurdles our schools encounter and the positive impact that collaborative community efforts can achieve. My mission is straightforward: provide a safe learning space for our children by addressing their needs, supporting their experience, and investing in their success.

Having received the unanimous endorsement of the Ocean View Teachers Association, I am truly humbled and deeply proud to have the backing of our community leaders, families, teachers, and support staff.
My intent now is to earn your trust and your vote.
Whether questions arise or you’re texting to let me know I can count on your vote, I look forward to hearing from you.

Jennifer Rank
